name: Brill: turning in 'Deaths in the Family' to Coleman Farthing plays his yell and thank-you (#6391)
contract: When 'Deaths in the Family' (354) is rewarded at Coleman Farthing 1500 he yells creature_text group 0
(broadcast 2631) about 1 s later and says group 1 (broadcast 2632) to the player about 5 s after that, as
TrinityCore 2017_09_26_12_world_335.sql scripts it and Wowhead Classic records both quotes for him.
'The Haunted Mills' (362), also ended by Coleman, is the negative control and plays no RP.
SMSG_MESSAGECHAT 150 starts with the one-byte chat type and the int32 language; both texts use Orcish 1, so the
first uint32 is 270 for the MONSTER_YELL 14 and 268 for the MONSTER_SAY 12. This verifies server packet delivery
to the socketless session, not client chat rendering or the questgiver flag toggle.

steps.label: SETUP: 'The Haunted Mills' is ready to turn in
the hero turns in 362 to Coleman
SETUP: 'Deaths in the Family' is ready to turn in
the hero turns in 354 to Coleman
DISCRIMINATING: Coleman yells about the Agamands
steps.text: Hah!  Eternal undeath to the cursed Agamands!

steps.label: DISCRIMINATING: Coleman thanks the hero
steps.text: You have tempered the cold rage in my heart.
